description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No.61 of 1979  Declare the Essential Public Services
reasoning: The gazette content is an order by the President, issued under the authority of the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. Its primary function is to declare a wide range of services as "essential public services" due to severe weather, which is a regulatory action that modifies the legal status and obligations related to those services. While it involves the President (a government person), it does not detail his personal portfolio responsibilities or make structural/personnel changes. Instead, it creates a binding legal/regulatory framework under an existing Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
